agent_evaluations.additional_comments: This evaluation reveals a systematic failure in the MCQ generation process. Despite having RAG citations with adequate confidence scores (0.75-0.78), the actual clinical content was never populated. The questions are templates ('A patient presents with [condition]'), options are placeholders ('Option A/B/C/D'), and explanations are incomplete ('the most appropriate approach is...'). This is NOT a medical content quality issue - it is a generation pipeline failure. No psychiatric expert can evaluate placeholder content for SAFE-T compliance, Mental Health Act accuracy, or medication safety. The entire batch of 100 MCQs must be regenerated with actual clinical scenarios before any meaningful clinical review is possible. Current status: UNUSABLE for medical education.
